append.detail: Operators edit each tier's title, intro and ordered steps in place on /admin/content/training (community staff write; stored as JSON over the code registry in platform_settings training_curriculum, no seed row; reward stays in code; Reset to default per tier). Every step carries a stable id, and training_paths.completed_steps (migration 20270346002100) stores a trainee's completion per step from a done toggle on /training, which shows N of M and moves the path to started. A relabel or reorder keeps progress.
